title: Wickham overlay document
description: A partial override applied over the registry. Overlays carry VALUES ONLY - they may not introduce a field, nor change its units, source or sweep, because that would let a run invent an input outside the registry's provenance rules. The resolver rejects an overlay key that is not already a registry field, and rejects a value outside the field's sweep unless that key is listed in allow_outside_sweep with a justification.

overlay.description: Identifier, e.g. 'S2', 'WEEKDAY', or a run tag.

allow_outside_sweep.description: Field keys this overlay may set outside their declared sweep. Each entry must be justified in 'justification'. For deliberate stress tests, never for routine runs.
